scope: commercial name, public discoverability, game-store collision reconnaissance, trademark and domain preflight

naming_reset.reason: The previous naming system produced vague pseudo-poetic fantasy compounds without enough semantic, cultural or narrative grounding.
naming_reset.rule: No previous title, Domain, location, faction, character or UI proper noun is considered approved merely because it exists in content, code, localization, artwork plans, package identifiers or prior QA evidence.

rejected_candidates.name: Veredas da Trama
rejected_candidates.reason: Rejected by the product owner as vague, artificial and disconnected from a convincing world identity.

historical_reconnaissance.note: All previous public/store/trademark reconnaissance for the rejected title is historical only and must not be reused as clearance for the replacement title.

41.reason: game/entertainment service coverage relevant to online game services and entertainment
41.wipo_basic_indication: game services provided online from a computer network

official_methodology_evidence.reuse_boundary: Class methodology may be reused; candidate-specific searches, domains and handles may not.

completion_requirements: define the world premise, cultures, geography and naming languages before bulk renaming
select a memorable final title from semantically grounded candidates
replace rejected user-facing proper nouns with names justified by world context
complete exact and confusingly-similar human search in INPI classes 9 and 41 for the selected title
complete WIPO/global human cross-check for the selected title
confirm desired domains/social handles or explicitly accept alternatives
record final name decision and trademark filing strategy or explicit no-filing decision
verify store listing name can be created without material collision
decide whether the Android application ID must change before public release
